title: PhysioWave-T: Token-Efficient Wavelet Foundation Models for Biosignals
abstract: arXiv:2611.08969v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present PhysioWave-T, a token-efficient wavelet foundation model family for EEG, ECG, and sEMG. Dynamic scale folding recombines $J+1$ wavelet subbands before tokenization, reducing the sequence from $(J+1)CS$ to $CS$ tokens for $J$ decomposition levels, $C$ channels, and $S$ temporal patches. Route-specific front ends and learned channel-name embeddings allow one Transformer per modality to handle diverse montages and sampling rates. Unseen configurations reuse the pre-trained backbone through a lightweight front end. We pre-train a 30M-parameter EEG model on over 15M windows spanning 19 to 128 channels, alongside ECG (30M) and sEMG (12M) encoders. Across four EEG routes, scale folding cuts Transformer latency by 4.0--7.2x and peak memory by 6.8--12.7x relative to scale expansion without accuracy loss. translated_title: PhysioWave-T：面向生物电信号的高效Token小波基础模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了PhysioWave-T，一个面向脑电图（EEG）、心电图（ECG）和表面肌电图的高效Token小波基础模型系列。动态尺度折叠技术在分词之前重新组合J+1个小波子带，将序列从(J+1)CS个Token减少到CS个Token（其中J为分解层数，C为通道数，S为时间片段数）。针对不同导联的专用前端和可学习的通道名称嵌入，使每种模态仅需一个Transformer即可处理多样化的导联组合和采样率。对于未见过的配置，可通过轻量级前端复用预训练的主干网络。我们在覆盖19到128通道的超过1500万个窗口上预训练了一个30M参数的EEG模型，同时还预训练了ECG（30M）和sEMG（12M）编码器。在四个EEG导联上，尺度折叠相比尺度展开方法可将Transformer延迟降低4.0至7.2倍，峰值内存降低6.8至12.7倍，且不损失精度。我们的EEG编码器在与BENDR、BIOT、LaBraM和EEGPT的对比中，在九项指标中的八项上领先，并在可穿戴设备癫痫检测上超越了LUNA-L。
tldr: PhysioWave-T通过动态尺度折叠技术将小波子带的Token数量大幅压缩（延迟降低4-7倍、内存降低7-13倍），构建了面向EEG、ECG和sEMG生物电信号的高效基础模型系列，在性能上超越了现有最先进方法。
en_tdlr: PhysioWave-T introduces dynamic scale folding that drastically compresses wavelet subband tokens (cutting latency 4-7x and memory 7-13x), creating a token-efficient foundation model family for EEG, ECG, and sEMG biosignals that outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
